definitions.explanation: A person who arranges marriages or acts as an intermediary between two parties at a wedding ceremony. Traditionally an important role in Japanese marriages.

examples.japanese: {仲人|なこうど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: To ask someone to be a matchmaker.

examples.japanese: {仲人|なこうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{合|あ}わせた。
examples.english: The matchmaker introduced the two of them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仲人|なこうど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てない→立てる：01196_tateru⟧⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, weddings without a go-between have been increasing.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仲人|なこうど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to have a go-between (at a wedding)
- {仲人|なこうど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to ask someone to be a matchmaker
- {仲人|なこうど}⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧: the role of go-between

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally, Japanese weddings required a {仲人|なこうど} couple (married pair) who would introduce the bride and groom and oversee the wedding. This role has become less common in modern Japanese weddings.
